analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY26, driven by fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management. During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and is scheduled to take delivery of another offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27. Management remains optimistic about industry tailwinds, including Maritime India Vision 2030 and increased offshore energy investments. For FY27, the company expects a conservative 10% top-line growth and stable EBITDA margins between 45% and 50%. ABS Marine Services Limited reported a consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: The company expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for the current financial year FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the EBITDA margin will continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the tax rate for FY27 to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market are supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as Maritime India Vision 2030 and a support package for shipbuilding.
demand_outlook.quote: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as the Maritime India Vision 2030, which outlines over 150 strategic initiatives with projected investments of INR3 lakh crores to INR3.5 lakh crores, along with the recently announced INR69,725 crores support package for shipbuilding.

demand_outlook.claim: Global offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of $15 million for both new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion.
capex_expansion.quote: Received Delivery of Offshore Vessel – AM PASSION

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin of 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores, EBITDA surged to INR94.23 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year. EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 12 vessels, including smaller vessels on long-term charters.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90 percent of revenue.
ABS Marine secured an offshore charter contract from Larsen & Toubro Limited for a DP2 Platform Supply Vessel.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured Offshore Charter Contract from L&T

orders_capacity.claim: The AM Passion vessel was deployed under a charter with Schlumberger Asia Services Limited with a tenure of 3 years firm plus 3 years optional extension.
orders_capacity.quote: AM PASSION Deployed Under Schlumberger Charter

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio and funding is not a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that premium increases on vessel acquisitions are driven by exchange rate fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: For the well stimulation vessel AM Passion, charter rates are fixed at $16,000 per day for three years, and the next three years will be at $19,000.
management_commitments.quote: There has been a few inquiries by SLB for conversion of one of the Emerald or the Diamond and taking it to the Gulf because she is also draft sensitive. So, we are still waiting for them.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
